summary: Adds force attributes to metaball fields for Particle SOP or Spring SOP attraction, repulsion, axial, vortex, and spiral force behavior.
common_gotchas: Force SOP is not a general geometry transform; it writes force attributes for particle/spring workflows.
Use metaball hull display to inspect the affected force field.
Keep force values modest because large scales can make Particle/Spring SOP motion unstable.
key_concepts: Force SOP adds force attributes to metaball fields for Particle SOP and Spring SOP dynamics.
Radial force generally attracts with positive values and repels with negative values.
Directional force enables axial, vortex, and spiral components along the specified direction vector.
Metaball weights affect the resulting force field strength and falloff.
